investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Finworks Care (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west4 (zones europe-west4-a/europe-west4-b/europe-west4-c); network range 10.134.0.0/16; Database: patients-db-01 holds patients records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Apache Airflow and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
